    # motif quadrant: which interval contains r0,c0
    mr=[i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(ranges_r) if a<=r0<=b]; mc=[j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(ranges_c) if a<=c0<=b]
    qr=ranges_r[mr[0]]; qc=ranges_c[mc[0]]
    # other intervals
    others=list(zip([i for i in range(len(ranges_r)) if i!=mr[0]],ranges_r),
                   [j for j in range(len(ranges_c)) if j!=mc[0]],ranges_c)
    for ri,qri in others:

    # simpler: brute force offsets = difference between quadrant origins
    origins={}
    for idx,a,b in enumerate(ranges_r): origins[f'r{idx}']=a
    for idx,a,b in enumerate(ranges_c): origins[f'c{idx}']=a
    # motif cells relative to its origin (qri index)
